text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain felt satisfying, but past gains do not predict future prices; I should decide based on each stock's prospects, not the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake; assess each holding on its merits rather than treating it as a separate account.","I made no trades for several periods while my account value fluctuated, reminding me that restraint can be reasonable—but I should review the whole portfolio, not assume inaction is always best."]}
